mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(dic_key),0) FROM sys_dictionary WHERE dic_sort = #{dicSort}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dictionary SET dic_value = CASE WHEN dic_key = 'white_list' THEN #{iplistVO.whiteList} WHEN dic_key = 'black_list' THEN #{iplistVO.blackList} END WHERE dic_sort = 'iplist'
UPDATE sys_dictionary SET dic_value = CASE WHEN dic_key = 'wechat_appid' THEN #{wechatVO.wechatAppid} WHEN dic_key = 'wechat_appsecret' THEN #{wechatVO.wechatAppsecret} END WHERE dic_sort = 'wechat'
